description: KNaTi₄(PO₄)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. K is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.69 Å. Na is bonded in a hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.64 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.94 Å) and three longer (1.98 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.93 Å) and three longer (1.98 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-29°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Ti, and one P atom.
